title: Backend Engineering: SDE 1 → 3
prereqs: A running kind cluster for the deploy challenges
description: From SDE-1 fundamentals to SDE-3 system design: REST & gRPC API design, relational & NoSQL data modeling, indexing & transactions, caching (Redis), message queues & event-driven architecture, concurrency, idempotency & rate limiting, auth, and scaling patterns (sharding, consistency, CAP) — building and deploying real services.
